title: Runner
description: A 3D endless runner: three lanes, obstacles to dodge, jump or slide under, coins to pick up, sixty seconds or three hits. The shared bull with blended run, jump, slide, hit and knockout animation, a sound set and a music loop from the asset library, and the HUD kit. Replace the obstacles, the speed curve, the scoring and the scene; keep the shape of src/game.ts (the engine) and src/App.tsx (the shell).
